pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with smooth-curved edges and low angularity. Patch size is largest on the mid-flank, reducing in area towards the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored pathways forming a network of triple-junction nodes. Pathways are narrow and well-defined on the upper flank, becoming wider and lower in contrast on the ventral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, erect mane visible on the upper neck with a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant desaturation and contrast loss in the pelage pattern on the lower ventral region compared to the high-contrast dorsal patterning.
